## Direct scope-enforcement correction ΓÇö 2026-10-05

Following Matthew's PR415 feedback and explicit request to improve workflow QA, implementation and independent QA must verify the complete **published reviewer-facing scope**, not only the net final file diff. Bind the actual target repository/ref/SHA, head, merge-base, declared parent identity/state and ultimate target separately. Inspect all pages of the live PR's ordered commits/parents and changed paths/renames, reconcile totals and map every commit/file to the issue or a necessary prerequisite/test/contract.

A clean final tree does not excuse unrelated commits, temporary evidence add/update/delete churn, or parent/sibling merges that expose unrelated changes in commit review. Preserve evidence on dedicated retained refs without introducing it into product history. Necessary migrations remain allowed with explicit scope rationale and tests; no blanket migration ban or arbitrary commit-count target. Missing/truncated inventories, unexplained content or identity races withhold readiness. Parent merge/rewrite/retargeting requires new actual-range assessment; synthetic integration evidence cannot replace it.

Coordinator will bind and recheck this scope inventory with final verdict/receipt before and after readiness. Existing immutable evidence and prior receipts remain historical. No force-push/history erasure is authorized as a shortcut; original owners must propose a safe correction.

Canonical workflow original owner `01a108a2-e15d-7046-928a-1a709ae250d9` continues existing draft PR2 under turn `01a10de5-e4c2-7224-8e32-1cc41e0a2ac5` to add the shared guard, templates and maintained regression cases. Earlier PR2 receipt is historical for this change. Current execution pins remain unchanged with this direct amendment; same independent QA must assess the revised guide.
